title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): Control transaction isolation for queries and isolated storage (Query ReadState supports ReadCommitted)
summary: BC29 lets AL queries set ReadState to ReadCommitted so they read only committed data, and it adds isolation level choice for isolated storage reads, including row locking for safer read-modify-write work. This extends to queries what the ReadIsolation method gave Records in BC22.
key_points: Query ReadState options are ReadUncommitted (default), ReadCommitted, ReadExclusive and ReadShared
ReadCommitted reads committed data only, but rows may change during the transaction
ReadExclusive places update locks and ReadShared places share locks on rows read, blocking changes by other transactions
ReadUncommitted allows dirty reads but can perform better than the locking modes
Mirrors the Record ReadIsolation method introduced in BC22

quotes.text: ReadCommitted: Reads only data that has been committed to the database. Rows read are not guaranteed to remain consistent throughout the current transaction.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the trade-off between consistency and performance with the new ReadCommitted isolation level

quotes.text: Setting the property to ReadUncommitted can improve performance compared to ReadShared and ReadExclusive.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the performance implications developers should consider when choosing isolation levels
